title: kb_http.py logs each request's client address and request line to stderr
goal: kb_http.py's log_message no longer writes the client address or the request line of a request to stderr; its line is structured (method, status, milliseconds) without the address or the question, so a host journal holds no personal data; hosted lookups stay out of the query log.

run: import sys,io;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kb_http;a='.'.join(['203','0','113','7']);h=object.__new__(kb_http.Handler);h.client_address=(a,5555);h.server=type('S',(),{'quiet':False})();buf=io.StringIO();sys.stderr=buf;h.log_message('%s','GET /x HTTP/1.1');sys.stderr=sys.__stderr__;sys.exit(1 if a in buf.getvalue() else 0)
